title: The Shadow
narration: In twenty nineteen, we captured a black hole's shadow on a glowing ring—the boundary where gravity locks the door.
visual_goal: Show M87*'s orange ring, then zoom into dark center.

title: The Point of No Return
narration: Sagittarius A*, our galaxy's core, has an event horizon of point zero eight astronomical units—the distance from Sun to Mercury. To escape, you'd need to outrun light, impossible.
visual_goal: Animate sphere, light rays bending and trapped.

title: The Ripples
narration: In twenty fifteen, two black holes (thirty-six and twenty-nine solar masses) merged, sending ripples that stretched Earth. We've detected ninety+ such events, confirming Einstein.
visual_goal: Ripples distort star grid, two masses merge.

title: The Temperature of Nothing
narration: Black holes leak Hawking radiation. A solar-mass hole is sixty nanokelvin, taking ten^sixty-seven years to evaporate—long after all stars fade.
visual_goal: Faint glow, stars dying in time-lapse.

title: The Unseen Mass
narration: Our galaxy hosts ~one hundred million black holes, but we've imaged only two: M87* and Sagittarius A*. What lies beyond the edge remains unknown.
visual_goal: Pan Milky Way, settle on Sagittarius A* image.
